# Add Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher with wave toggle and multi-theme dropdown

## Context

Prerequisite engine leaf for the standalone-examples theme switcher Engine 14 release blocker (`@tobiu`, `2026-11-21`). Today `apps/portal/view/ViewportController.mjs:302`, `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs:882`, `examples/code/livePreview/MainContainer.mjs:102`, and eight `examples/grid/*/MainContainer.mjs` files each hand-roll `Neo.main.DomAccess.startViewTransition` for binary light/dark toggling, while `5`-theme examples (`board/*`, `scheduler/*`, `gantt/*`, `timeline/*`) and `4`-theme examples (`menu/context`) have no reusable multi-theme dropdown switcher at all.

## The Problem

1. Without a first-class engine button component, adding theme switching across ~80+ non-workbench examples would duplicate `startViewTransition` + icon/label sync logic dozens of times.
2. Binary toggles (`neo-theme-neo-light` ↔ `neo-theme-neo-dark`) cannot switch among `3+` themes (`neo-theme-neo-light`, `neo-theme-neo-dark`, `neo-theme-light`, `neo-theme-dark`, `neo-theme-cyberpunk`), whereas `2`-theme apps should keep the fast 1-click sun/moon circular-wave toggle rather than requiring two clicks in a dropdown.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/main/DomAccess.mjs:1321` already provides `Neo.main.DomAccess.startViewTransition({delay, reveal: {x, y}, windowId})` in the main thread, gracefully resolving when `document.startViewTransition` or `prefers-reduced-motion` skips animation.
- `src/button/Base.mjs` (`Neo.button.Base`) already supports `menu` (`Neo.menu.List` lazy-created via `beforeSetMenu` / `afterSetMenu`), `iconCls`, `text`, `ariaLabel`, and `ui`.
- Sibling placement (`structural-pre-flight` Stage 1 fast-path): `src/button/ThemeSwitcher.mjs` (`ntype: 'theme-switcher'`) sits directly beside `src/button/{Base,Split,Menu,Effect}.mjs`, with structural styles in `resources/css/src/button/ThemeSwitcher.css` and theme tokens in `resources/css/theme-{neo-light,neo-dark,light,dark,cyberpunk}/button/ThemeSwitcher.css`.
- Design authority: `n/a — new engine button subclass encapsulating the established Portal/Workstation view-transition wave + multi-theme menu pattern`.

## The Fix

1. Create `src/button/ThemeSwitcher.mjs` (`className: 'Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher'`, `ntype: 'theme-switcher'`, extending `Neo.button.Base`):
   - `themes_` reactive config (`String[]|null`, defaulting to `null` -> reads `Neo.config.themes`).
   - Canonical theme label/icon map (`'neo-theme-neo-light': 'Neo Light'`, `'neo-theme-neo-dark': 'Neo Dark'`, `'neo-theme-light': 'Light'`, `'neo-theme-dark': 'Dark'`, `'neo-theme-cyberpunk': 'Cyberpunk'`, with clean fallback formatting for custom theme names).
   - Resolves target component via `resolveThemeTarget()` (`this.target ? Neo.getComponent(this.target) : this.up('viewport')`), reading current theme via `target.getTheme() || themes[0]` and observing `target`'s `theme` config (`observeConfig`) so external or URL theme changes keep the button/menu state synchronized.
   - **2-theme mode (`effectiveThemes.length === 2`):** Clicking toggles directly to the other theme after awaiting `Neo.main.DomAccess.startViewTransition({delay: 100, reveal: {x: data?.clientX, y: data?.clientY}, windowId: this.windowId}).catch(() => {})`; updates sun/moon icon (`fa-solid fa-sun` / `fa-solid fa-moon` or crisp inline CSS/glyph fallback when FontAwesome is not loaded in standalone examples — **critical**: standalone examples like `gantt/basic` and `scheduler/basic` do NOT load FontAwesome in `index.html`, so `ThemeSwitcher.css` MUST render crisp pure-CSS/SVG sun, moon, palette, and chevron indicators without depending on external icon fonts!).
   - **Multi-theme mode (`effectiveThemes.length > 2`):** Opens a floating `Neo.menu.List` (or lightweight anchored dropdown list) showing all configured themes with the active theme marked (`aria-checked` / active indicator); selecting a theme runs `Neo.main.DomAccess.startViewTransition` from the pointer coordinates (falling back to button center on keyboard `Enter`) and sets `target.theme = selectedTheme`.
2. Add `resources/css/src/button/ThemeSwitcher.css` and `resources/css/theme-{neo-light,neo-dark,light,dark,cyberpunk}/button/ThemeSwitcher.css` so `ThemeSwitcher` looks polished out of the box in any toolbar across all 5 themes at both desktop and `390 × 844` mobile widths (compact icon+label or icon-only `compact` option for narrow mobile toolbars!).
3. Add unit/component + E2E tests (`test/playwright/unit/button/ThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` and/or `test/playwright/component/button/ThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs`) covering 2-theme wave toggle, 5-theme dropdown selection, keyboard operation, font-free icon rendering, and `observeConfig` sync.

| `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` (`ntype: 'theme-switcher'`, `src/button/ThemeSwitcher.mjs`) | `src/button/Base.mjs`, `src/main/DomAccess.mjs:1321`, `apps/portal/view/ViewportController.mjs:302` | `themes.length === 2` toggles light↔dark on click with `startViewTransition` circular wave; `themes.length > 2` opens theme dropdown and applies selected theme with circular wave | Instant `target.theme = nextTheme` when `startViewTransition` is unsupported or `useViewTransition: false`; pure-CSS/SVG icons requiring no FontAwesome stylesheet | JSDoc `@class` + `@summary` on `src/button/ThemeSwitcher.mjs` | Playwright unit/component spec + 5-theme build guard |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` (`ntype: 'theme-switcher'`) works with zero external icon-font dependency (no broken squares in examples whose `index.html` loads only `MicroLoader.mjs`).
- [ ] With 2 configured themes, clicking toggles `viewport.theme` between them after `Neo.main.DomAccess.startViewTransition` circular reveal from click coordinates, and reflects URL `?theme=` boot state accurately.
- [ ] With 3+ configured themes (e.g. all 5 shipped themes), activating the control opens a keyboard- and pointer-accessible dropdown listing every configured theme, highlights the active theme, and switches `viewport.theme` with `startViewTransition` circular reveal on selection.
- [ ] Supports a compact responsive presentation (`showText: false` or automatic compact styling below `768px`) so narrow `390 × 844` example toolbars do not overflow.
- [ ] `node ./buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all`, `npm run check-theme-surfaces`, `check-theme-value-files.mjs`, `check-theme-var-references.mjs`, and new Playwright specs pass.

## Out of Scope

- Mounting `ThemeSwitcher` across the ~80 standalone examples (handled by the parallel family rollout leaves blocked by this ticket so peers can land all examples cleanly once this merges).

## Avoided Traps

- **Relying on `fa-solid fa-sun` / `fa-moon`:** most standalone examples (`examples/gantt/*`, `examples/scheduler/*`, `examples/board/*`) do NOT load FontAwesome CSS in `index.html`, so `fa-*` classes render nothing or tofu! Use pure CSS / inline data-URI / VDOM SVG glyphs inside `ThemeSwitcher`.
- **Assuming `viewport.theme` is non-null before first switch:** per `apps/portal/view/ViewportController.mjs:285`, read `target.getTheme() || effectiveThemes[0]` so the first click always switches away from the rendered boot theme.
